shared_tail.surface: عبد الرحمن بن زياد بن أنعم الإفريقي

notes: «حدثنا خالي، يعلى» : the kinship word «خالي» before a name makes one link whose surface is the name alone (يعلى).
The tail follows «جميعا عن» and the text writes it once after the last «ح».
The kunya «أبو بكر» is written as it stands and not identified.
